title: React.js
simpleMetaphor: Interactive LEGO blocks for building web pages with reusable components.
technicalExplanation: A component-based UI library utilizing a Virtual DOM for efficient client-side rendering.

title: Next.js
simpleMetaphor: React with built-in routing, server rendering, and automatic SEO optimizations.
technicalExplanation: Fullstack React framework featuring Server Components, SSR, SSG, and API Routes.

title: Vue.js
simpleMetaphor: A progressive, approachable framework for quickly building dynamic user interfaces.
technicalExplanation: Progressive UI framework using proxy-based reactivity and Single File Components.

title: Nuxt.js
simpleMetaphor: The Next.js equivalent for Vue developers, adding SSR and server routes automatically.
technicalExplanation: An intuitive Vue framework for building server-rendered and static web applications.

title: Svelte
simpleMetaphor: Compiles your code directly into tiny JavaScript at build time without a Virtual DOM.
technicalExplanation: A component framework that converts app declarations into surgical vanilla JavaScript during build.

title: SvelteKit
simpleMetaphor: The official fullstack application framework built on top of Svelte.
technicalExplanation: Application framework for Svelte offering file-system routing, SSR, and API endpoints.

title: Astro
simpleMetaphor: Generates ultra-fast static HTML and ships zero JavaScript by default unless specified.
technicalExplanation: Islands Architecture framework designed for content-driven sites with multi-UI framework support.

title: Remix
simpleMetaphor: A fullstack React framework focused on native web standards, form submissions, and resilient routing.
technicalExplanation: React framework emphasizing web primitives, nested routing, dynamic data loading, and mutations.

title: Angular
simpleMetaphor: A complete enterprise toolkit by Google with strict structural conventions.
technicalExplanation: Opinionated TypeScript framework featuring dependency injection, RxJS, and native CLI tools.

title: HTMX
simpleMetaphor: Extends HTML to make AJAX requests and swap page sections directly without writing heavy JS.
technicalExplanation: Library allowing access to AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets, and SSE directly in HTML attributes.

title: Web Components
simpleMetaphor: Custom HTML tags supported natively by browsers without requiring any framework.
technicalExplanation: Suite of W3C web standards (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, HTML Templates) for encapsulated UI widgets.
